name: Morin
summary: Morin is finished entirely in vintage brass, giving the pot a warm, glowing patina with a refined metallic depth. The uniform surface creates a clean, sculptural silhouette that elevates any plant it holds, turning a simple vessel into a polished decorative accent. All painted in vintage brass 60.5x56x71.5
